text.offer: I am in need of allies. Please, prove your loyalty by fighting one of the Duke's soldiers. You should find one guarding a flagpole nearby. Come back and let me know you are done.
text.progress: Princess Kateriina will allow you to join the Royal army, but first you must prove your loyalty by slaying her enemies at the flagpoles.
text.complete: It is good that we can count you as an ally. Take this as a symbol of your commitment to the battle.

steps.brief: I am glad to see you have returned. Please fight one of the rebels. Tell me when you are done and you will be made a soldier.
